name: TrackPM Software
description_en:
TrackPM Software is a product in the Project management category. Its directory profile covers Project Templates, Custom Workflows, Kanban Board, Time & Expense Tracking, Task Management, Resource Management, Project Planning, IT Project Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are Large Enterprises Medium Business Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Not available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep), Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $1.0.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: move work items through defined process stages; create, assign and track units of work; allocate people, time and other project resources. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
TrackPM Software 属于项目管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括项目模板、自定义工作流、看板、工时与费用跟踪、任务管理、资源管理、项目规划、IT 项目管理。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 桌面应用 (Windows)。资料所列适用组织规模为大型企业 中型企业 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未提供。资料所列支持方式为全天候人工支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $1.0.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：让工作项在预设流程阶段间流转；创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；分配人员、时间和其他项目资源。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
